newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil completes Zeepipe IIB gas line.
newsitem.headline: Statoil completes Zeepipe IIB gas line.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it had completed laying the Zeepipe IIB gas trunkline from Kollsnes near Bergen and the Draupner E riser platform in the North Sea.

The 249-km line was originally due to be finished last year, but work fell behind schedule owing to technical problems on the LB 200 laybarge charged with laying the line, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
The setbacks pushed operations into the autumn when poor weather caused further delays.
The official starting date for first gas deliveries through Zeepipe IIB is October 1. Investment in the line is roughly three billion crowns, Statoil said.
